'''Blanca Nikols''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who was married to [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Arrin Nikols]], a member of the [[InterStellar Regulators]]. She had a son named [[Ritte Nikols]]. They resided on [[Makeb]] during the [[Galactic War]].<ref name="Extraordinary">{{TORcite|exp=rothc|type=faction|Republic|Extraordinary Measures|Makeb}}</ref>
